# fundament_namespace (Resource)

A namespace of a Fundament project. Fundament creates it on the project's cluster as `tnt-<project>--<name>`, binds the project's admins to the Kubernetes role `admin` and its viewers to `view` there, and deletes it when the resource is destroyed. A namespace created directly in the cluster, with kubectl, is not a Fundament namespace: Fundament does not list it and creates no bindings in it. To deploy into the namespace, use the cluster's kubeconfig from the console or `functl cluster kubeconfig <CLUSTER_ID>`, with the `cluster_id` of the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fundament_namespace" "example" {
  name         = "app"
  project_name = "my-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the namespace, unique within the project. In the cluster it is `tnt-<project>--<name>`.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster where this namespace is deployed. Derived from the project.
- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster where this namespace is deployed. Derived from the project.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that owns this namespace. Either project_id or project_name must be specified, but not both.
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project that owns this namespace. Either project_id or project_name must be specified, but not both.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The timestamp when the namespace was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the namespace.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import fundament_namespace.example <namespace-id>
```
